strategy.overview: 2001, Dimension, and Galaxie share four colored five-target groups and five upper saucers, but their awards differ. On 2001, completing a color lights its matching saucer and lane from 50 to 300; completing three or four colors lights Special according to setup. Dimension and Galaxie convert paired color completions into Add-A-Balls, 1,000-point bumpers, and WOW targets. In either version, bank shots across the target faces are safer than the central stand-ups.
strategy.simpleOverview: In 2001, shoot the colored drop groups and finish one color at a time. Each completed color lights its matching upper saucer and lane for 300 instead of 50; complete the configured three or four colors for Special. Dimension and Galaxie use Add-A-Ball and WOW awards instead, so identify the title before following the final award route.
strategy.summary: Start with the center saucer, then bank shots across the colored drops. Finish green and red first on 2001 because their lights improve return lanes; the other colors improve outlanes. Avoid the four central stand-ups unless their configured award is worth the rebound.

quickInfo.name: Center saucer
quickInfo.summary: Score 300 and use it as the first-ball plunge target on 2001.

quickInfo.name: Complete one color
quickInfo.summary: Light its matching saucer and lane for 300 instead of 50 on 2001.

quickInfo.name: Complete three or four colors
quickInfo.summary: Light Special on 2001 according to the installed card.

quickInfo.name: Green and red groups
quickInfo.summary: Light the two return lanes on 2001.

quickInfo.name: Dimension/Galaxie pairs
quickInfo.summary: Use paired color completions for Add-A-Ball, lit bumpers, and WOW awards.

steps.text: On 2001, plunge the center saucer for 300 before any colored saucer has been lit.
Bank controlled shots across one colored five-drop group instead of shooting the central stand-ups.
Finish green or red first to light its matching saucer and return lane for 300.
On a later plunge, choose a lit colored saucer whose kickout can return to another saucer or a safe feed.
Complete the configured three or four color groups for Special; on Dimension or Galaxie, follow the paired-color WOW and Add-A-Ball lamps instead.

buildsToward.title: Completed color groups and lit upper awards

steps.text: Use its improved saucer and lane on the next trip up top.
Repeat across the required colors for Special on 2001 or the paired WOW/Add-A-Ball route on Dimension and Galaxie.

machineSetup: Identify 2001, Dimension, or Galaxie before play. On 2001, confirm whether three or four completed color sets light Special; on Dimension or Galaxie, confirm Add-A-Ball and WOW conversion and which completed side resets when the ball leaves play.

Test all twenty colored drops, each group-completion relay, five saucers and kickouts, matching colored lanes, Special or WOW lamps, Dimension/Galaxie bumper upgrades, central stand-ups, target resets, and the target-to-sling return geometry.
